Message.Name: Control Message
Message.Description: System specific information the Ids provides to Data Vendors, of one of four types

Field.Name: Message Type
Field.Description: The Category's type

Field.Name: Control Message Text
Field.Description: The control message the Message Type selects

Message.Name: Start of Day Control Message
Message.Description: First message transmitted to the Data Vendors, signalling the start of the trading day and that the Ids is ready to process information packets sent by the trading platform

Message.Name: Administrative Message
Message.Description: General information that may be of value to the investors, disseminated whenever the exchange decides

Field.Name: Free Text
Field.Description: The actual message, of any size between one and four hundred characters, written in English

Message.Name: End of Day Control Message
Message.Description: Last message transmitted to the Data Vendors, signalling the end of the trading day and that the Ids has concluded its operation

Message.Name: Line Verification Control Message
Message.Description: Transmitted on a minute basis while the data dissemination line remains idle, verifying to the Data Vendors that the Ids continues uninterrupted. It does not increment the Sequence Number and is excluded from retransmission

Message.Name: Trade Message
Message.Description: Transmitted when an instrument trade occurs in the trading platform or the clearing system

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: The Instrument's fifteen character symbol

Field.Name: Board ID
Field.Description: The trading board under which the instrument is being traded

Field.Name: Trade number
Field.Description: Unique for the trading day

Field.Name: Buy order number
Field.Description: The sequence number of the buy side order being matched

Field.Name: Buy order date
Field.Description: The date the buy side order was entered into the trading system

Field.Name: Sell order number
Field.Description: The sequence number of the sell side order being matched

Field.Name: Sell order date
Field.Description: The date the sell side order was entered into the trading system

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The trade's price

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The trade's volume

Field.Name: Total Volume
Field.Description: The total number of stocks or contracts traded up to that point

Field.Name: Trade Type
Field.Description: Whether the trade is new or an edit of one already reported

Field.Name: Trade Source
Field.Description: The system the trade came from

Field.Name: Buy order type
Field.Description: The type of the buy side order

Field.Name: Sell order type
Field.Description: The type of the sell side order

Field.Name: Buy Waiver Indicator
Field.Description: Waiver flags for the buy side, a bit mask spelled as four numeric characters

Field.Name: Sell Waiver Indicator
Field.Description: Waiver flags for the sell side, a bit mask spelled as four numeric characters

Field.Name: Notional amount
Field.Description: Trade value

Field.Name: Buy ALGO flag
Field.Description: Algorithmic transaction flag of the buy side. Y is flag on and any other value is flag off

Field.Name: Sell ALGO flag
Field.Description: Algorithmic transaction flag of the sell side. Y is flag on and any other value is flag off

Field.Name: SDIV flag
Field.Description: Special Dividend transaction flag. Y is flag on and any other value is flag off

Field.Name: DUPL flag
Field.Description: Duplicative Trade reports flag. Y is flag on and any other value is flag off

Field.Name: TimeStamp
Field.Description: Time the message was created in the Trading System, as local time to the microsecond

Message.Name: Quote Message
Message.Description: Transmitted when at least one side of the supported Quote levels for the given instrument becomes changed. The Ids will not send a Quote level that contains no data

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: The Instrument's fifteen character symbol

Field.Name: Quote Levels
Field.Description: The number of Bid and Ask levels contained in this message for the given instrument

Field.Name: Quote Level
Field.Description: One Bid and Ask level of the given instrument

Message.Name: Index Message
Message.Description: Transmitted every time the trading platform calculates the price of a given index

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: The Index's fifteen character symbol

Field.Name: Index Price
Field.Description: The calculated value of the Index

Message.Name: Instrument Summary Message
Message.Description: Transmitted for each instrument right after the corresponding market status changes to End of Day

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: The Instrument's fifteen character symbol

Field.Name: Opening Price
Field.Description: The Instrument's opening price

Field.Name: High
Field.Description: The highest price with which the given Instrument was traded, during the trading day

Field.Name: Low
Field.Description: The lowest price with which the given Instrument was traded, during the trading day

Field.Name: Last
Field.Description: The last price with which the given Instrument was traded, during the trading day

Field.Name: Closing Price
Field.Description: The Instrument's closing price

Field.Name: Start Of Day Price
Field.Description: Usually the previous day's closing price adjusted, if necessary, from various corporate actions

Field.Name: Total Volume
Field.Description: The sum of the volumes of all Instrument trades occurred, during the trading day

Field.Name: Total Value
Field.Description: The total value traded in the given Market for the given Instrument, during the trading day

Message.Name: Closing Price Message
Message.Description: Transmitted for every instrument whose closing price has been calculated by the trading platform, and again whenever the trading platform recalculates one

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: The Instrument's fifteen character symbol

Field.Name: Closing
Field.Description: The Instrument's closing price, as Oasis calculated it

Field.Name: Open Interest
Field.Description: Total number of outstanding contracts

Message.Name: Projected Auction Auction Open Projected Close Price Message
Message.Description: Transmitted whenever the trading platform calculates a Projected Auction, Auction Open or Projected Close price for the instrument

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: The Instrument's fifteen character symbol

Field.Name: Price Flag
Field.Description: Which of the three prices the message carries

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The Instrument's projected or auction open price, or the Instrument's projected close price when applicable

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The Instrument's projected or auction open or Projected Close volume

Field.Name: TimeStamp
Field.Description: Time the message was created in the Trading System, as local time to the microsecond

Message.Name: High Low Limit Modification Message
Message.Description: Transmitted at the beginning of the trading day, and whenever the static High and Low limits for the given instrument change

Field.Name: Symbol

Field.Name: Ceiling Price

Field.Name: Floor Price

Field.Name: Start Of Day Price
Field.Description: The start of day price of the instrument

Field.Name: Accrued Interest

Message.Name: Instrument State Message

Field.Name: Volume

Field.Name: Matched Volume
